chunks: Lawful is all game of the water for you, and eating of it as food, so that you and the travellers may benefit by it. But unlawful is game of the jungle when you are on pilgrimage. Fear God before whom you have to gather in the end.

key_terms.تُحْشَرُونَ: You will be gathered (on Judgment Day)
key_terms.صَيْدُ الْبَرِّ: Game of the land / Land animals

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between hunting in the sea and on land during Hajj in Islam?
ai.summary: This verse (5:96) establishes the permissibility of sea game for both pilgrims and travelers, a ruling that Shia jurists often extend to include all aquatic creatures, distinguishing it from the specific prohibition of land game during Ihram. It highlights the unique status of the sea as a source of sustenance that remains accessible even in the sacred state, reinforcing the balance between ritual purity and practical necessity. The concluding exhortation to 'fear God' underscores the spiritual dimension of these legal distinctions, reminding believers that their actions are always under divine observation.
